name: Dual Contouring on Octree
definition: A recursive octree traversal and contouring algorithm that extracts a mesh by processing leaf nodes, cell faces, and cell edges to generate vertices and triangle indices.
summary: Dual Contouring on Octree is an adaptive surface extraction method that uses an octree hierarchy and Quadratic Error Functions to generate triangle meshes, reducing polygon count in flat regions while preserving detail in complex areas.
